_comment: Skirmisher-screen subcommander directive (#1467). Team 1 runs the new 'screening' doctrine: three heavy blocks holding their line, with one archer unit spawned behind the middle one. On the first AI tick the subcommander pushes the archers out ahead of the line to contest the ground between the armies (SKIRMISH stance); the player line is then walked forward by a scripted box-select and right-click, and once it closes inside the withdraw trigger the same subcommander recalls the archers -- back through the INTERVAL between two blocks, not through a block. Deterministic (scenario + seed + doctrine + scripted input).
